wizard.title: Setup Wizard
wizard.description: Configure your Auto Claude environment in a few simple steps
wizard.helpText: This wizard will help you set up your environment in just a few steps. You can configure your Claude OAuth token, set up memory features, and create your first task.

firstSpec.title: Create Your First Task
firstSpec.subtitle: Describe what you want to build and let Auto Claude handle the rest
firstSpec.taskCreatorOpenedDesc: Great! You can create your first task now or continue with the wizard. You can always create tasks later from the main dashboard.
firstSpec.continueHint: You can continue with the wizard now or create more tasks.
firstSpec.skipHint: You can skip this step and create tasks later from the dashboard.

beDescriptive.title: Be Descriptive
beDescriptive.description: Clearly describe what you want to build. Include requirements, constraints, and expected behavior.

startSmall.title: Start Small
startSmall.description: Begin with a focused task like adding a feature or fixing a bug. Smaller tasks are easier to verify.

includeContext.title: Include Context
includeContext.description: Mention relevant files, APIs, or patterns. The more context you provide, the better the results.

letAIHelp.title: Let AI Help
letAIHelp.description: The AI can generate titles and classify tasks. Focus on describing what you want, not the details.

example.title: Example Task Description:
example.content: "Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page. It should persist the user's preference in localStorage and apply the theme immediately without page reload. Use the existing color variables in styles/theme.css."

welcome.title: Welcome to Auto Claude
welcome.subtitle: Build software autonomously with AI-powered agents

aiPowered.title: AI-Powered Development
aiPowered.description: Generate code and build features using Claude Code agents

specDriven.title: Spec-Driven Workflow
specDriven.description: Define tasks with clear specifications and let Auto Claude handle the implementation

memory.title: Memory & Context
memory.description: Persistent memory across sessions with Graphiti

parallel.title: Parallel Execution
parallel.description: Run multiple agents in parallel for faster development cycles

oauth.title: Configure Claude Authentication
oauth.subtitle: Add your Claude accounts to enable AI features
oauth.description: Connect your Claude account to enable AI features
oauth.infoText: Add multiple Claude subscriptions to automatically switch between them when you hit rate limits.
oauth.runSetupToken: Run claude setup-token to get your token
oauth.successMessage: You have at least one authenticated Claude account. You can continue to the next step.

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Auto Claude Memory helps remember context across your coding sessions
memory.description: Auto Claude Memory helps remember context across your coding sessions
memory.dbAutoCreateDesc: Memory uses an embedded database - no Docker required. It will be created when you first use memory features.
memory.memoryDescription: Memory stores discoveries, patterns, and insights about your codebase so future sessions start with context already loaded.
memory.noEmbeddingHint: No embedding provider? Memory still works with keyword search. Semantic search is an upgrade.

completion.title: You're All Set!
completion.subtitle: Auto Claude is ready to help you build amazing software
completion.setupCompleteDescription: Your environment is configured and ready. You can start creating tasks immediately or explore the application at your own pace.

createTask.title: Create a Task
createTask.description: Start by creating your first task to see Auto Claude in action.

customizeSettings.title: Customize Settings
customizeSettings.description: Fine-tune your preferences, configure integrations, or re-run this wizard.

exploreDocs.title: Explore Documentation
exploreDocs.description: Learn more about advanced features, best practices, and troubleshooting.

completion.rerunHint: You can always re-run this wizard from Settings → Application

ollama.notRunningDesc: Start Ollama to use local embedding models. Memory will still work with keyword search.
ollama.selectModelHint: Select an installed model for semantic search. Memory works with keyword search even without embeddings.

graphiti.title: Memory & Context
graphiti.subtitle: Enable Graphiti for persistent memory across coding sessions
graphiti.configuredSuccessDesc: Memory features are enabled. Auto Claude will maintain context across sessions for improved code understanding.
graphiti.dbAutoCreateDesc: LadybugDB uses an embedded database - no Docker required. The database will be created when you first use memory features.
graphiti.graphitiDesc: Graphiti is an intelligent memory layer that helps Auto Claude remember context across sessions. It uses a knowledge graph to store discoveries, patterns, and insights about your codebase.

features.understanding: Better understanding of your codebase over time
features.noDocker: No Docker required - uses embedded database

graphiti.enableGraphitiDesc: Uses LadybugDB (embedded) and an LLM/embedding provider
graphiti.apiKeyNote: Note: API key validation currently only fully supports OpenAI. Your key will be saved and used at runtime.
graphiti.ollamaNote: Note: Ollama connection will be tested by checking if the server is reachable.
